A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE THINKING

Good question.
Glad you asked.

New idea. A few questions.
Let’s get you up to speed.

What exactly is UniMarkaz?+

UniMarkaz is a university student marketplace being built in Pakistan. It’s a place to offer your skills, find help, and connect with students across universities — from tutoring and design to coding, project collaboration, bike pooling and more.

Can I earn money while I’m at university?+

That’s the idea. You could offer tutoring, design, coding, photography or other useful services to students who need them. You set your own rates and arrange payment directly. Finding paid work will depend on your skills and demand; joining the waitlist doesn’t guarantee earnings.

What if I’m looking for help instead?+

You’re in the right place. UniMarkaz is also for finding a tutor, a creative collaborator, technical help or a campus connection. Choose “I need a hand” or “A bit of both” when joining the waitlist.

Can students from any university join?+

Yes. The waitlist is open to students from all universities. We’re starting with Pakistan’s student community, with the aim of connecting you both within your university and beyond it.

When’s the launch? And is joining free?+

We’re building UniMarkaz now and haven’t announced a launch date yet. Joining the waitlist is free and doesn’t commit you to offering or booking anything. We’ll email you about beta opportunities and the launch. Features and categories may evolve as we build.

What happens to my email?+

We collect your email and selected interest to send you UniMarkaz beta and launch updates. Signups are processed through SplitForms. You can ask to leave the list by replying to any update. This page doesn’t use advertising trackers, analytics cookies, or browser storage.
